R1.description: Every logged set of the exercise in focus shows the pencil and opens the correction sheet for that set, filled with its own values; pending rows don't

R2.description: Saving changes only the set that was opened, found by its id; other sets are stored as they were and the set keeps its id, order, createdAt and warm-up flag; a missing set changes nothing and reports the failure

R3.description: A corrected RPE on an earlier set changes the recommendation workout completion stores, as a logged one does

R4.description: The sheet comes back on the same set after a rotation, never opens on another set or with another set's values and closes if its set is gone; Undo last still removes only the most recent set, and apart from the pencil the rows' look is unchanged

R5.description: Saving a correction leaves the steppers, the rest timer and the suggestion strip as they are
